segments.sn35.140:1.2: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn35.140:1.3: Aniccasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, cakkhu kuto niccaṃ bhavissati … pe … jivhā aniccā.
segments.sn35.140:1.5: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya sopi anicco.
segments.sn35.140:1.6: Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, jivhā kuto niccā bhavissati … pe … mano anicco.
segments.sn35.140:1.8: Yopi, bhikkhave, hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn35.140:1.9: Aniccasambhūto, bhikkhave, mano kuto nicco bhavissati!
segments.sn35.140:1.10: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati … pe … jivhāyapi nibbindati … pe … nibbindaṃ virajjati;
segments.sn35.140:1.11: virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.140:1.12: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: 137-145. Catutthaṃ suddhikaṃ katvā desiyamāne bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttaṃ.
Pañcamādīni tathā tathā bujjhantānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttāni.
Tathā tathāti ajjhattikāni bāhirāni ca āyatanāni aniccalakkhaṇena dukkhānattalakkhaṇehi ca yojetvā dassanavasena.
